Name: Generating Text-Based Lessons: Formats, Layouts, and Content Types
Description: This lesson covers the range of web-ready text content PreseMaker can produce, including accordion, printable, WordPress, and Markdown layouts, as well as content types such as Topic Overview, Topic Detail, lesson plans, example problems, and suggested sources. Learners will practice selecting visual themes for HTML output and understand when to use a Topic Overview versus a Topic Detail.
